max_tire.note: NIVA-FAQ owners report that a 205/70R15 clears on ET ~20–45 wheels, but a 205/75R15 rubs the front of the arch at full lock and the rear arch at full droop. Alloys need tapered-seat nuts with a shoulder; don't use the steel-wheel nuts.
The 2017 Lada 4x4 Bronto runs Bontyre Stalker 235/75R16s with ground clearance raised another 35 mm and plastic arch protection.

items.title: Upper steering shaft may crack (Russia)
items.summary: Voluntary recall of 3,300 Lada 4x4s because the end of the upper steering shaft could crack. Never sold new in the US, so NHTSA has no Niva campaigns.

tsbs.title: Front CV joints with more splines (Z = 24)
tsbs.summary: VAZ began fitting front-wheel drive joints with an increased spline count on the 21213 family in 2004, so match replacement joints and shafts to your truck.

tsbs.title: Maintenance-free front hub bearings
tsbs.summary: Bearings that don't need adjusting, a revised steering knuckle, independent front-axle mounting and gas shocks. Owners retrofit the 21214 knuckles, hubs and bearings to older trucks.

tsbs.title: Transfer-case centring
tsbs.ref: Workshop procedure (Руководство по обслуживанию и ремонту)
tsbs.summary: The fix for driveline vibration: dynamic centring of the transfer case on its mounts, with height shims on the VAZ-2121.

timeline.change: Series production of the VAZ-2121 begins in Tolyatti on 5 April: 1.6 carburettor four, four-speed gearbox, full-time 4WD with lockable centre differential
Export debut at the Paris salon. UK sales begin in November (left-hand drive until February 1983)
Lada Canada adds the Niva for the 1981 model year and sells more than 12,000 in the first year
Around now, early chrome details and the red-background badge disappear. Pre-1985 trucks are the collectors' Nivas
VAZ-21213: 1.7 Solex carburettor engine, five-speed gearbox, 3.9 axles, deeper tailgate and new interior. The 21214 with GM single-point injection follows (1994)
Series production of the five-door VAZ-2131 (500 mm longer wheelbase, 65-litre tank)
Final Canadian model year: the last Lada sold in Canada. A VAZ-2131 is dropped at the North Pole and another reaches Everest base camp
Renamed Lada 4x4 after GM-AvtoVAZ takes the Niva name; the carbureted 21213 is dropped
21214M updates (finished in 2011): reworked rear suspension, new clutch, better brakes, Chevrolet Niva parts, power steering on all models. ABS from 1 October 2011
October: front hub bearings that don't need adjusting, revised knuckles, independent front-axle mounting, gas shocks
Rosstandart recall of 3,300 Lada 4x4s for possible cracks in the upper steering shaft (29 November)
Renamed Lada Niva Legend in January, after a 2020 facelift that ended the pickup
Sanctions halt production. The Classic'22 returns in July without ABS, EBD or ERA-GLONASS, and the five-door ends in January
June update: 90 hp 1.8 VAZ-11184, Vesta ventilated discs, single transfer-case lever, driver's front airbag; production from 20 July, sales from 31 August

identify.intro: Every US Niva is an import, and many variants share the same body, so check what you're actually looking at before you pay for it.

items.head: VIN
items.body: AvtoVAZ's VIN is XTA (manufacturer), six characters for the type and variant (for example 212100 for a VAZ-2121), one character for the model year, and a seven-digit serial. Hagerty's records show XTA212100E… for a 1984 and XTA212100P… for a 1993. AvtoVAZ starts each model year on 1 July. The plastic data plate is on the right-hand body side panel.

items.head: 2121 or 21213/21214
items.body: The 1.6 VAZ-2121 has VAZ-2106 horizontal tail lights, a high loading lip, a four-speed and the old VAZ-2106 dashboard. From 1993–94 the 1.7 trucks have vertical tail lights, a tailgate that reaches the bumper, a five-speed and a VAZ-2108-style dash. The VAZ-21219 (1991–94) is a hybrid: the old body with the new 1.7 drivetrain.

items.head: Early details
items.body: Pre-1985 trucks have a chrome grille surround and sill trim, and a red-background front badge. They're rare in good condition and the ones collectors pay for.

items.head: Export variants
items.body: The 21212 is the right-hand-drive UK version (1983–95), the 21211 a 1.3 for high-tax markets, and the 21215 a Peugeot-diesel export model (1999–2007). The Cossack was a UK and importer trim package, not a factory model.

items.head: Not a Niva
items.body: The Chevrolet Niva (VAZ-2123), sold since 2020 as the Lada Niva and then Niva Travel, is a different and newer design. Bronto-built derivatives such as the long Fora (VAZ-212180) carry their own X7G VIN prefix.

values.intro: Still cheap by vintage 4x4 standards, but rising. Restored and very original early trucks are pulling ahead, while rusty drivers stay affordable.
values.note: Based on five Bring a Trailer Niva sales: $5,300 for a 1989 Italian cabriolet (2019), $8,900 for a 1993 (2024), $15,100 for an '85 (January 2026), $13,400 for a 1991 (May 2026) and $27,777 for a restored 1977 (October 2026). Hagerty also records a rust-bubbled condition #4 1984 sold at Monterey for $14,000.

paragraphs: Ladas were never sold new in the US; Wikipedia says trade sanctions kept them out. NHTSA's exemption covers vehicles at least 25 years old, counted from each vehicle's date of manufacture, so as of October 2026 any Niva built before late 2001 can be imported. That covers every carbureted 1.6 and 1.7 and the early injected 21214s and five-door 2131s. The EPA exemption for vehicles 21 years and older in original configuration is separate; keep both sets of paperwork.

Canada sold the Niva new from the 1981 to the 1998 model year, so Canadian trucks are left-hand drive and familiar to North American inspectors. The Nivas Bring a Trailer has sold in the US came from Spain, the Netherlands and Estonia, and one restored truck came from Russia. Russian-origin goods have been charged at Column 2 tariff rates since the Suspending Normal Trade Relations with Russia and Belarus Act of April 2022, and Proclamation 10420 raised the rate on 576 tariff lines to 35%. Ask a customs broker about duty on a Russian-built vehicle before you buy, wherever you're shipping it from. State titling and emissions rules vary, and California is the hardest.

editions.name: Cossack
editions.note: UK importer package with decals, roof rails, running boards and 15-inch alloys, plus a sunroof, bull bar and rear spare on some. Restyled in 1995 with a Rover-designed grille.

editions.name: Hussar
editions.note: UK base model in original 1977 trim, with the 1.7 and deeper tailgate.

editions.name: Plein Soleil
editions.note: French convertible conversion by coachbuilder Wassermann; Italian importers built cabriolets too.

editions.name: Urban
editions.note: Plastic bumpers, new grille, power windows and mirrors, air conditioning; five-door Urban from 2015.

editions.name: Bronto
editions.note: Factory off-road special: 235/75R16 tyres, +35 mm clearance, winch, roof lights and plastic body protection.

editions.name: 40th Anniversary
editions.note: Limited edition in 1977-style trim with leather seats, stainless sills and badges.
